settings.label: What it does
settings.title: What it does
settings.text:
Not another multivitamin. The next generation of one. MUTO gives you the active vitamins and minerals you’d want from a good multivitamin, plus the cellular science most leave out: NR for NAD⁺, CoQ10, PQQ and resveratrol.

Five jobs in one daily jar: energy that holds through the afternoon, recovery from a busy week, a clearer mind, ageing well and immunity. Two capsules, 19 ingredients, one jar instead of five pots.

settings.label: How it works
settings.title: How it works
settings.text:
Every cell makes its own energy, in tiny power stations called mitochondria. NAD⁺ is the courier that carries energy from your food to them, all day. From your mid-30s your body makes less of it: fewer couriers, the same work.

You notice it in your day before you’d call it ageing: afternoons that fade, busy weeks that take longer to bounce back from. It’s like your body has switched to low power mode.

MUTO gives your cells NR, which they turn into NAD⁺, plus what helps them use it: active B vitamins, CoQ10 and PQQ for your mitochondria, and zinc and copper to help protect your cells. Not a stimulant. A better baseline, built every day.

Go deeper: the science, made simple.

settings.label: Formula
settings.title: Formula
settings.text:
19 ingredients, every dose on the label. No proprietary blends, no fillers.

  • Energy: NR 300mg, CoQ10 150mg, PQQ 20mg and the active B vitamins.
  • Recovery: vitamin D3 2,000 IU, B2, CoQ10 and PQQ.
  • Mind: B6, B12, folate (5-MTHF) and zinc.
  • Ageing well: NR with TMG 450mg, trans-resveratrol 50mg, grape seed extract 150mg and vitamin K2 100µg.
  • Immunity: vitamin D3, zinc 15mg and copper 1mg (both bisglycinate), folate, B6 and B12.

Vegan capsules, made in the UK to GMP standards, every batch tested. See all 19 ingredients and our standards.

settings.title: Who it's for
settings.text:
Adults in their 40s, 50s and 60s. Most of our customers are in their 40s and 50s: still working, keeping up with family and the things they love, and not ready to slow down.

It’s for you if your afternoons fade sooner than they used to, busy weeks take longer to bounce back from, or you’re taking five supplements and don’t know which one’s working.

You don’t need to be sporty or own a smartwatch. And it’s not for anyone chasing a buzz: no caffeine, no stimulants.

settings.label: What it does
settings.title: What it does
settings.text: Creatine is the fast reserve your muscles draw on when effort spikes: the hard rep, the sprint, the last station. It helps you repeat hard efforts with less drop-off, so you get more out of every session. It's one of the most researched supplements there is, and now it's in the same routine as your NAD+ Cellular Complex.

settings.label: How it works
settings.title: How it works
settings.text: At the start of a sprint, a heavy lift or a steep climb, your muscles burn through their ready supply of ATP in seconds, faster than your mitochondria can remake it. Creatine is stored in muscle as phosphocreatine, a reserve that rebuilds ATP almost instantly, so the next rep, stride or effort has something to draw on. MUTO NAD+ Cellular Complex looks after the steady supply. Creatine looks after the fast reserve. Two energy systems, one routine.

settings.label: Formula
settings.title: Formula
settings.text: Ultrapure creatine monohydrate, the most studied form, and nothing else in the tub. It's micronised into a finer powder, so it mixes cleanly into water, coffee or a smoothie with no grit. ≥99.9% pure, every batch tested. The same standard as everything we make: nothing hidden.

settings.label: Who it's for
settings.title: Who it's for
settings.text: For people who train to stay strong for longer: the Hyrox athlete chasing faster stations, the fifty-something lifting to keep up with his kids, the woman who knows strength training isn't just for bodybuilders. MUTO NAD+ Cellular Complex supports the steady energy you run on all day. MUTO Ultrapure Creatine Monohydrate supports the fast reserve your muscles draw on when effort spikes.

settings.label: Protocol
settings.title: Protocol
settings.text: One 5g scoop a day, every day, with your first meal alongside your NAD+ Cellular Complex capsules. Any drink works. Consistency beats timing, so there's no loading and no cycling. Stores build over a few weeks, and the scales may nudge up slightly as your muscles hold more water. That's expected, and it isn't fat. Track it where it shows: note your reps at a set weight, interval splits or station times before your first scoop, and compare after a few weeks.
